Training / Learning Resources · v4.2

Complete POC update · 3 October 2026

Resource association

Select a Project and its Training Plan Code when uploading a resource. Upload stores the file and the plan association together. Batches using that exact plan inherit the linked resource according to its availability policy. The repository shows the project for each linked plan, the plan code, and matching batches in the current user's scope.

Resource types

PPT, PPTX, PDF and video are supported. MP4 and WebM are the initial demo multimedia extensions. Other multimedia formats require inclusion in the administrator's approved-format list. Extension validation is demonstrated; production file inspection is outside this local POC.

Business rules

  1. Every uploaded resource requires a project and a training plan belonging to that project.
  2. A common resource can be linked to multiple plans, including plans belonging to different projects. Publishing a resource as common does not automatically link it to all plans.
  3. A trainer can upload resources only when the upload permission is provided, and only to permitted plans.
  4. A trainer may optionally request addition of their uploaded resource to the common repository. Administrator publication is the POC review workflow; the business publication authority remains to be confirmed.
  5. A new link can include existing and new batches using the plan. When this option is not selected, the new resource is available to batches created after the link. An administrator can later include existing batches through Batch availability; that change is audited.

Review walkthrough

Open resources.html under the Schoolnet Admin persona. Use Permissions & approved formats to grant a trainer upload access and review multimedia extensions. Upload a PPT/PPTX, PDF or approved video with its Project and Training Plan. Select common publication and existing-batch inclusion as needed. Use Link to another plan to reuse a common resource across projects. Use Batch availability to inspect the exact linked plans and matching batches. Switch to the trainer or trainee persona to verify scoped availability.

POC boundaries

Files are stored in this browser's IndexedDB and metadata in local browser storage. Previously provided placeholder resources have no uploaded file bytes. Batch association does not override linked training-day access or project expiry. Shared storage, secure server permissions, file scanning and durable audit require a backend. Administrator publication and historical propagation are explicit prototype review controls.
